newsitem.title: USA: PhoneTel says it will buy phone companies.
newsitem.headline: PhoneTel says it will buy phone companies.

text.p: PhoneTel Technologies Inc said Tuesday it has agreed to buy American Public Telecom Inc, Advanced Pay Systems Inc and London Communications Inc for about $15 million in cash.

The company said the acquisitions of these privately-held companies, along with previously announced acquisition of Communications Central Inc, would result in administrative staff reductions. A company spokeswoman declined to identify the number of jobs cut.
The company said it expects the acquisition of the three companies to increase by about 4,000 the number of pay telephones it owns and operates.
In March, Standard & Poor placed PhoneTel's single-B corporate credit rating on CreditWatch with negative implications following the company's announcement of plans to acquire Communications Central,
Standard & Poor said it would evaluate the company's projected cash flow contribution from the Communications acquisition before resolving the CreditWatch listing.
